messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT: Dedicated pool 'nhz-prod-tenant' (NewHorizon - enterprise VPC) GPU utilization >95% for 6m, queue depth rising. SLO error spikes for generation endpoints. Severity: P1. Paging @sre-oncall. Metrics: https://grafana/redwood/pool/nhz-prod-tenant
sre-oncall: On it. Acknowledge P1, rolling in. Who's got the latest on autoscale config and contract burst allowances?
support-liz: Customers reporting 503s + timeouts for NHZ API key. Support ticket #INC-12345 opened, ~120 affected requests/min, error rate ~28% last 5m. Customer-facing status message prepared but holding until we know mitigation.
eng-runtime: Quick snapshot from runtime logs: `pool=nhz-prod-tenant GPUs_used=63/64 queued=42 avg_gen_latency=2300ms tail_p95=4200ms`. Autoscaler hit max_replicas=64 ~10m ago and stopped scaling. Model pods are queuing; some OOM preemptions noted but not primary.
infra-tom: Confirmed. Autoscale policy for this pool: min=8 max=64, burst_cap configured separately. There is a contractual burst allowance for this tenant but requires ops approval for manual override into shared capacity.
acct-success-maya: NewHorizon contract: emergency burst allowed up to 16 GPUs into shared overflow when both parties agree and incident declared. They've given prior verbal OK for emergency burst, but we should notify their SLA contact.
ops-manager-oliver: Noted. We need quick impact calc + risk of cross-tenant spill. If we can contain to encrypted overlay + audit logs and limit to 16 GPUs, approve. Request: SRE + Eng to perform manual scale and routing changes, inform CS to notify customer.
sre-oncall: I approve proceeding with manual burst under those constraints. Assigning tasks: @eng-runtime do scale + routing changes; @infra-tom coordinate capacity reservation; @support-liz notify customer once poc is done.
eng-runtime: Doing manual scale now. Command I'm about to run:```
redwoodctl pool-scale --pool nhz-prod-tenant --gpus 80 --burst 16 --reason "P1 live mitigation - approved by ops"
```
infra-tom: Pre-check: available spare GPUs in shared pool = 22. Will reserve 16 and mark them as encrypted-overlay. Making reservation in infra console now.
support-liz: Notifying NewHorizon contact (mike@newhorizon): "We are initiating an emergency burst to add capacity to your dedicated pool to mitigate degraded API responses. We'll follow up with timeline and postmortem."
eng-runtime: Scale command complete. New pool state: GPUs_used=79/80 queued=6 avg_gen_latency=480ms. Starting routing shift to move non-critical routes to smaller model variants to reduce token burn.
sre-oncall: Monitoring. Error rate dropping (28% -> 6% over 8m). Good sign. Logging the decision and approvals.
infra-tom: Reservation confirmed. Audit ticket created ID=AUDIT-7782 (includes operator, timestamp, reason).
acct-success-maya: Confirmed customer notified and accepts emergency burst. They requested ETA for full recovery and postmortem; I've scheduled a 1:1 with their platform lead.
eng-runtime: Implementing soft fallback for heavy requests: `route-config set nhz /generate model_variant=small --traffic=30%` to shed load. Also enabling KV warm-up for the hot models.
sre-oncall: Action items: 1) Keep burst limited to 16 GPUs and monitor until queue=0 and p95<1s. 2) Run capacity regressions to ensure no noisy neighbor impact. 3) Post-incident review with timeline + root cause. Who will own follow-up?
ops-manager-oliver: I'll own post-incident review and approve follow-up remediation. Assigning infra-tom + eng-runtime to produce RCA. Support-liz to own customer comms until resolved.
support-liz: Updated ticket INC-12345: "Mitigation in progress — emergency burst initiated; error rate decreasing. Next update in 30m."
incident-bot: HANDOFF: SRE oncall -> follow-up window. Incident state: mitigated (errors reduced), monitoring for full recovery. Paging resume window set for 60m.
sre-oncall: Leaving this as monitored. If metrics stay stable for 30m, we'll move to postmortem. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
ops-manager-oliver: Documenting cost impact + contract notes for billing. Will also propose change: increase max_replicas to 80 with auto-approval threshold for tenants with burst contracts.
eng-runtime: Noted. I'll capture the runtime traces and config diffs for the RCA.
support-liz: I'll send the customer an interim status email and schedule the post-incident call.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: root cause likely autoscale cap (max_replicas hit) combined with sudden traffic spike from NHZ nightly batch. Next: RCA and PM to recommend longer-term config changes.
